query_text: Create a course planner app for my phone where I can pick classes one by one and see the total credits add up as I go, with a clear list of everything I've selected and a running credit counter so I know when I've hit the required amount.

Build a mobile app that helps me figure out my investment risk appetite, with a short step-by-step questionnaire covering things like how long I plan to invest and how much loss I can handle, then shows me a clear profile result at the end saying whether I'm conservative, moderate, or aggressive.

Need a delivery preference manager app for my phone that lets me set how often I want packages delivered — daily, every few days, or weekly — and shows me a simple summary of my chosen schedule with options to easily switch between them.

Create a research paper finder app for my phone that lets me filter journals by impact factor range, so I can quickly narrow down which papers are worth reading and stop wasting time scrolling through low-quality sources.

Need a symptom checker app for my phone that lets me filter symptoms by how severe they are and when they started, so I can quickly figure out which ones to pay attention to first and stop guessing what's going on.

Make a compliance document manager app for my phone where I can filter all the legal documents by which country or region they apply to, so I stop wasting time digging through documents that have nothing to do with my jurisdiction.

Create a marketplace browsing app for my phone that lets me filter seller listings by their rating, so I can see only the trustworthy sellers at the top and stop dealing with sketchy ones who waste my time.

A portfolio tracker app for my phone where I can filter my holdings by asset type — like stocks, bonds, or cash — and also by region, so I can quickly see what I have in each category without manually sorting through everything myself.

Create a leaderboard app for my phone where I can filter rankings by region and age group, so I can see how I stack up against people in my own area and age range instead of being buried in a global list that means nothing to me.

Make a support ticket manager app for my phone that filters the queue by how urgent each issue is, so the most time-sensitive ones show up first and I stop missing tickets that are about to breach their deadline.

An employee directory app for my phone that lets me filter staff by department and job level, so I can find the right person to contact quickly and stop scrolling through hundreds of names every time I need someone specific.

Make a friend request manager app for my phone that lets me decline incoming requests and also gives me the option to block that person right away, so I can deal with unwanted requests cleanly in one tap and move on.

Create a subscription manager app for my phone that lets me pause an active subscription and shows me a grace period countdown during which I can still get a refund, so I have a clear window to change my mind without losing money.

Create a data cleanup app for my phone where I can choose which categories of stored data to reset — like history, saved searches, or preferences — instead of wiping everything at once, so I keep what I still need and only clear what I actually want gone.

Make a document sharing manager app for my phone where I can see who currently has editing access, then tap to remove someone's write permission when the collaboration is done, with a simple confirmation step so I don't accidentally lock the wrong person out.
Need a notification rule manager app for my phone that lets me turn off an alert rule without deleting it, so the rule gets archived and I can find it later if I ever want to switch it back on.

A referral code manager app for my phone where I can see all active codes with their expiry dates, select a batch of expired or unwanted ones, and deactivate them all at once so my list stays clean and I stop having to handle them one by one.

Need a linked accounts manager app for my phone that lets me unlink a saved bank account, and before it actually removes it, shows me the current balance so I can confirm there's nothing left and I'm not disconnecting the wrong account by accident.

Need a location history cleaner app for my phone that lists all my past check-ins or visited places, lets me pick and choose specific entries to delete, and removes only those without touching the rest of my history.

Build a legal professional profile app for mobile where a lawyer can fill in their bar registration details — license number, practice areas, admitted jurisdictions — and the whole thing feels polished and authoritative, like something you'd see on a premium legal directory, clean typography and a sense of credibility on every screen.

Create a patient health profile app for my phone where someone can log their baseline health history — things like chronic conditions, past surgeries, allergies, and regular medications — and the layout feels calm and trustworthy, like a well-designed clinic record rather than a cluttered form.

Need a community member profile app for my phone where someone can set up their role within a religious group — like whether they're a regular member, a volunteer, or in a leadership position — and the whole feel is warm and welcoming, something that reflects the spirit of the community rather than feeling cold or official.

Create a personal finance profile app for my phone where I can set up my budgeting personality — like whether I'm a careful saver, a casual spender, or somewhere in between — and the look feels fresh and motivating, with a vibe that makes managing money feel personal and even a little enjoyable.

An expat community profile app for my phone where members can fill in their home city, the languages they speak, and where they're currently living, with a warm and globe-trotting visual feel — the kind of aesthetic that makes you think of colorful city maps and multilingual connections rather than a dry registration form.

Make a buyer trust profile app for my phone that shows a person's reputation score as a marketplace buyer — based on things like completed purchases, on-time payments, and positive feedback — styled in a way that feels credible and reassuring, like a well-earned badge of trustworthiness rather than just a number.
